reviews.text:
We've been using their services for a year and a half now, since our dog was born. The Sakashita branch became the Iidabashi branch, and the groomer changed. The previous groomer moved to the Ichigaya branch. The groomers at Ichigaya are also very skilled, but it's difficult to get an appointment.

The new groomer at Iidabashi is incredibly meticulous, skilled at cutting, and makes us feel much more at ease leaving our dog there. They treat dogs with such love and care; I highly recommend them!

We've also tried other grooming salons besides Komachi in Kagurazaka and Azabu-Juban, but we've had sad experiences like messy clipping on the belly or nails being cut too short, causing bleeding.

That never happens at Komachi.

Every time, our dog becomes even cuter with the carbonated spring water and herbal pack treatments. Our dog loves the groomer too. We look forward to continuing to use their services.

I always bring my dogs in for grooming. I've added a second dog to my collection, and I'm so grateful that they accept appointments for both at the same time. They always carefully check everything when they're finished. I look forward to continuing to use their services!
I regularly go there for beauty treatments. I appreciate the stylish and comfortable atmosphere, the accurate advice, and the kindness of all the staff. It really lifts my spirits!

It's been over a year, but the results are always beautiful, and both of my dogs love this place and look forward to going.
All the staff are kind, and I feel safe leaving my dogs in their care, which is the best thing about this place.
Thank you.

My dog ​​is cared for here every month. The staff are all cheerful and polite, and the atmosphere in the store is great.
They carefully check for any stains on the teeth or the condition of the skin, and they even give advice, which is very helpful. It's easy to go unnoticed with things like weight changes, so it's great to be able to check every month.
My dog ​​is always so excited and happy when he comes here, so I feel that he is always loved. I hope to continue to use the store for many years to come.

The service is calm and polite, and the cuts are always perfect, so I feel at ease leaving my pet with them. I'm a bit of a germaphobe, so I'm really grateful that they can accommodate my individual requests. It's easy to communicate via the official LINE app, and I also find it helpful to be able to view the diary and photos of the finished product online. This is a salon I'd like to continue going to for a long time to come.
The groomer examines even the smallest details of my pet's body and provides a thorough report. It's a salon I can trust. It's especially reassuring for me since my pet has sensitive skin.
